name: MGTBench
description: MGTBench is the first benchmark framework for detecting machine-generated texts (MGTs) from powerful large language models. It evaluates various detection methods on public datasets and investigates robustness against adversarial attacks and text attribution tasks.
reputation: A well-cited early benchmark framework for machine-generated text detection that has been used as a reference point in the detection literature.
notes: Evaluates detection methods against texts from advanced LLMs; studies transferability and robustness under adversarial attacks.
